    1. get(Store, K)

Interface StateReader

public interface StateReader
Read access to the stores a process declared.

Reads are served from the shard of each store owned by the task delivering the message: partition p of every received topic shares one shard, and a key is found only if the delivering topic was keyed so that the same partitioner put it on p. To keep state about a different attribute than the delivered key, emit a message keyed by that attribute to a topic this or another process receives — a self-channel is a repartition. Producers outside Parsley must partition by the same rule.

  • Method Details

    • get

      <K,V> V get(Store<K,V> store, K key)
      Reads one value.
      Type Parameters:
      K - key type
      V - value type
      Parameters:
      store - the store to read, which the process must have declared
      key - the key to read
      Returns:
      the stored value, or null when the key is absent
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if store or key is null
      ParsleyFailClosedException - if store is not the instance the process declared (STATE_ACCESS_TO_UNDECLARED_STORE), or the key or the stored value cannot be coded by the declared serdes; the refusal is latched, so the step fails even if the handler catches it
